coverage: Initial verified Dublin City selection, not full coverage. Following a workspace loss, 55 known complete municipal announcements, 48 primary pages and 19 selected extra primary/ticket/reserve pages were freshly retrieved. Only selected programme facts were curated; this is not a new complete pagination crawl. Explicit current source intervals, admission and named venue pins are retained; uncertain endings are not asserted. Outer-county venues, sold-out programmes and conflicts remain held. Later dates and categories have gaps. Public Telegram review is separately dated; no automatic Telegram import or joining.
